src: Not that it matters. Sometimes I think no one cares about anything anymore, for good or bad.
Everyone else has become indifferent. Even the machines.
I heard they were much friendlier and caring back then.
Take care. Keep a low profile, right?
Want some advice? Don't hang out with the wrong people.
Them fleshies and them flesh people. Can't trust them.
I'm looking for a fleshy friend, actually.
Why would you want to be a friend to some of them monsters?
I'm already a friend. I'm looking for MORE friends for the Kraken.
You're either a pervert or just messing with me.
I don't wanna be friends with one of them. Please leave me alone.
Why can't I trust the fleshies?
They're gonna kill you. Hack you up, and then build a new Titan with your arms and liver and blood.
They're building new Titans from body parts?
You saw that yourself or heard that somewhere?
Didn't see it with my own eyes. But it makes sense, right?
Ha! You're just afraid to see the truth for what it is.
You'll remember this when the fleshies catch you.
Be careful out there. Don't let the fleshies catch you.
The Sleeper rests in quietude and peace.
An image is formed in your mind. Of a time long gone. Of violence, now forgotten.
An image of mountains and blood. Of a journey that is history but might come again.
Makes me feel a bit nauseous around here.
We have talked about your status already.
We encourage you now to follow the Surface Integration Course.
But you're free to leave any time you want.
Alright. Just follow the small corridor to Section Two.
Alright. Just continue towards Section One then.
It looks like the operation has been successful.
Do you remember who you are?
We still take interest in your well-being.
However, you have to leave us now. The danger of a possible contamination cannot be ignored.
Please don't try to return to your old habitat. We have put security measures in place to prevent this.
So what happens to me now? Where should I go?
This is not for us to answer. You're free to go anywhere, as long as you don't try to enter a habitat.
Here is all relevant info for you in written form in case you forget.
Your body will malfunction permanently when nearing one of our habitats.
The Surface Integration Course is standard procedure to teach you basic survival skills.
The course disables safety limits to better prepare you for the world outside.
Good luck, former citizen, and goodbye.
Your life will be terminated if you enter the prohibited zone.
This competition I got running. You gonna help me?
Sounds like fun. What do you need?
There's a lot of that pink glibber stuff in the Red Forest to the south of here.
It's gross. Never could stomach even looking at it.
It's gotta do something to my innards, right?
Alright. I'll get it for you.
It's about which of us can puke most.
I heard she's practicing a lot for this.
I don't wanna lose this time.
Ah, you brought me the stuff.
Thanks to you I could win that bet.
Hey, you! Do you think I can win?
I just don't know if I can.
Hey! You're not trying to cheat here, are you?
What's this person doing here then?
Take all the advice you can. You'll still lose.
Ok. So I need your help to win this.
My friend over there. Isn't he the cutest?
Look at him, how hard he's trying.
Just wait until he defeats you.
Oh, I don't plan on winning.
I just want him to feel good.
Of course. He can't know I'm helping.
He asked me to help him cheat.
Marvellous. I'm sure that winning will build him up a bit.
He won. By his own rules at least.
Can you see how confident he looks now?
There's some crusty puke on it.
The last patient who slept on this bed clearly had bladder problems.
You sure? You're not gonna cry when you lose, right?
Not bad, not bad. But look at this.
About the same as mine, but that was just warm up. Here's the real deal.
That's a lot. And why is there some pink stuff in it?
That's nowhere near enough. look at this.
I can't anymore. I give up.
Finally. I'm so happy, I could just...
Seems like nobody has used this bed in years. The sheets are still clean.
This must have been brought in from one of those old facilities.
I was a child. Now I am guardian.
You succeed in suppressing this creature's mind.
The Flesh Spikes pull back, opening the way.
{The creature stares at you with vacant eyes.}
This machine doesn't seem to be active here in this module.
Looks like people tried to break through or something.
Oh, this is a large one.
Hey, there. Welcome to the Shrine of the Heart.
The heart isn't here anymore, but we built a small garden for the worm it contained.
The worm was rescued by a great savior of our people.
I kind of imagined you would look more heroic.
But that's not important. Thanks so much for helping us.
Look for her. Look for her.
If she's here, talk to her. Talk to her.
These are our brothers and sisters. Brothers and sisters.
They are enhanced from humanity. Enhanced.
But they can barely move and talk.
And this room is so small.
They don't need room. They don't need to talk. They don't. They don't.
Master has made them better. Better.
You are the masters creation. Creation.
If you say so, you are right. Are right.
You should interact with the terminal over there. Over there.
I don't know your face. Your face.
But if you're here you're welcome. You're welcome.
What do you want to do?
This machine is missing a Machine Core.
The hierarch awaits you at the top. At the top.
Many people come here. Come here.
You will have to talk to the Hierarch. Hierarch.
You should talk to him, if you want to know more. Talk to him.
Why are you talking like this?
What do you mean? You mean?
I am just doing work for the Hierarch. Hierarch.
But an exam must be undertaken first.
Only the best are good enough to fit my army after all.
WARNING: Intruder detected. Running sterilization protocol.
FAILURE: Room could not be quarantined due to mechanical failure.
I may have seen one. Seen one.
But here I am alone. Am alone.
A challenge set to you by the Hierarch.
He gathers us, to make us strong. Make us strong.
Why are you talking like this?
I was asked this before. Before.
What do people mean, when they ask this? Ask this.
I am talking normally. Very normally.
You must have found a way to avoid the challenge. Avoid.
Is it because you tried to hide from it? Hide?
Is that the secret to your success? Success.
You have faced the challenge. The challenge.
Either with brawn or with skill. Brawn or skill.
Surely you must now recognize the danger this technology brings to us.
But the tower has not yet been conquered.
This floor requires wits to pass.
Use your head responsibly, and you may just go unharmed.
Go on, recruit. In preparation for the cause.
